text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Three people injured when unidentified persons set fire to a small store in the capital Manama.
- Bahrain exported goods worth 79 million dinars to Gulf Arab states in the first six months of 1996.
- Foreign Affairs Minister Sheikh Mohammad bin Mubarak al-Khalifa meets ambassadors of France, India and Algeria.
- Bahrain to host an international conference on aluminium in November 1997.
